pages.text: Orichalcum: reflection 5% a piece. Titan's breastplate: reflection 15%.$(br)Bulat: lifesteal 2.5% and divine ward 3% a piece. Kladenets: lifesteal 10%.

Dark iron: monster slaying 5% and divine ward 5% a piece. Heimdall's helmet 10%, Mjolnir and Surtr's sword 15%, the harpe 10% monster slaying.$(br)Nemean set: fury 5% a piece. Girdle of Hippolyta: fury 15% and lifesteal 5%.
Talaria: evasion 10%. Seven-league boots: 8%. Cap of invisibility: evasion 5% and divine ward 8%.
